data.desc: Headquartered in Cincinnati, LSI is a publicly held company and its common shares trade under the symbol LYTS on the Nasdaq Global Select Market. The Company manufactures advanced lighting, graphics, and display solutions across strategic vertical markets. The Company's products include non-residential indoor and outdoor lighting, print graphics, digital graphics, refrigerated and custom displays creating value for customer brands and enhance the consumer experience. LSI also provides comprehensive project management services in support of large-scale product rollouts. The Company employs approximately 3,000 people at 23 manufacturing plants in the U.S. and Canada.
